description: Load and internalize all required skills: module-authoring (13-section gold standard), safety-classification (Tier 1 vs Tier 2 boundaries, Pre/Trans note), developmental-vocabulary (Magenta/Purple word substitution, sincere-reader test), evidence-vetting (tier-rating system, polyvagal caveat rule), docusaurus-conventions (MDX components). Read amber-mythic-orientation.mdx as structural template.

Write module frontmatter matching Amber template pattern: id, title, sidebar_label, description, quadrants, level, lines, states, types, tags, difficulty, readingTime, practiceTime, prerequisites, line. Use 'magic-purple-stage-orientation' as id.

Write introduction with hybrid framing: educational content about this developmental stage, useful for facilitators and adults recognizing Magic-stage patterns in themselves. Include position-in-sequence statement.

Write Section 1 (AQAL Mapping): all 5 dimensions (Quadrants, Levels, Lines, States, Types) populated. Emphasize We (collective interior) and Its (collective exterior — the land, the tribe). Growing Up path included.

Write Section 2 (Theoretical Frameworks): four lenses — Spiral Dynamics Purple, Gebser magic structure, attachment theory (secure base / co-regulation), polyvagal-informed states (with Tier B caveat per evidence-vetting).

Write Section 3 (Gifts): 5+ items covering belonging, ritual, participation with living world, felt safety in tribe, meaning through story/repetition. Zero hedging language. Pass sincere-reader test (read as sincere Magenta-stage person).

Write Section 4 (Limitations / Shadows): structurally framed (no contempt language). Cover undifferentiated self/other boundary, magical causality, vulnerability to manipulation. Include Pre/Trans fallacy note.

Write Section 5 (Practice): Tier 1 only — education + journaling. Duration 10–15 minutes. Numbered steps. No somatic instruction, no shadow work, no identity disruption. Named 'Magic-Stage Recognition Practice' or similar.
Write Section 6 (Reflect): 5+ prompts. Cognitive/reflective only (no somatic check-in prompts — stay Tier 1). Mix journaling and dialogue prompts.
Write Section 7 (Assess): rubric with 3–6 behavioral criteria, passing threshold. Criteria focused on understanding and recognition skills, not practice execution.
Write Section 8 (Integrate): 3+ activities tied to existing daily moments, behavioral not conceptual.
Write Section 9 (Facilitator Note): proper framing for groups, adaptation notes for facilitators and non-Magenta audiences. Following Amber module's facilitator note pattern.
Write Section 10 (Anki Cards): 8+ Q&A pairs via RetrievalPrompt component. Mix matching: definition, application, distinction. Cover full module, not just frameworks.
Write Section 11 (Retrieval Schedule): 4 intervals, escalating from recall to application.
Write Section 12 (Evidence and Citations): 6+ sources, 4+ Tier A/B, polyvagal Tier B Player with contested-mechanisms caveat, APA 7th format.
Write Section 13 (Safety Note): Tier 1 template. Educational, not therapeutic. Stop rules. Grounding: feet on floor, name 5 things, slow breaths at settling pace.
Self-audit: 13-section checklist, vocabulary check (no contempt language, audience-appropriate framing), Pre-Club check, no therapeutic claims, no # heading in body.
Build verification: npm run build must pass with no errors or warnings for this module.
